title: Billing and Coding: B-type Natriuretic Peptide (BNP) Testing

covered.1: The correct use of an ICD-10-CM code listed below does not assure coverage of a service. The service must be reasonable and necessary in the specific case and must meet the criteria specified in this determination. The CPT code 83880 may be used for BNP or NT-proBNP testing.
